mapper.sql:
JOIN ( SELECT top.code AS top_cate_code, top.name AS top_cate_name, sub.code AS sub_cate_code, sub.name AS sub_cate_name FROM MARKET_CATEGORY AS top, MARKET_CATEGORY AS sub WHERE top.code = sub.main_cate ) AS main_category ON main_category.sub_cate_code = MP.cate_code
JOIN ( SELECT m.code, m.id, i.path, m.rating FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON m.code = i.target_code AND i.TYPE = 'profile' ) AS writer ON writer.code = MP.mem_code
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pick.prod_code, count(*) AS cnt FROM MARKET_PROD_PICK AS pick WHERE pick.delete_yn = 0 GROUP BY pick.prod_code ) AS pick_cnt ON pick_cnt.prod_code = MP.code
LEFT JOIN MARKET_PROD_PICK AS my_pick ON my_pick.prod_code = MP.code AND my_pick.mem_code = #{memberCode} AND my_pick.delete_yn = 0

MP.code, MP.title, MP.price, MP.hitcount, MP.deal_status, MP.created_at, MP.updated_at, main_category.TOP_CATE_NAME AS main_category_name, main_category.SUB_CATE_NAME AS sub_category_name, writer.code AS m_code, writer.id AS m_id, writer.rating AS m_rating, writer.path AS m_profile_image, IFNULL(pick_cnt.cnt, 0) AS count_pick, IF(my_pick.prod_code IS NOT NULL, 1, 0) AS picked_yn

sql.if: JOIN MARKET_CATEGORY AS MC ON MP.cate_code = MC.code

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM MARKET_PRODUCT AS MP

SELECT , i.path AS thumbnail FROM ( SELECT MP.* FROM MARKET_PRODUCT AS MP
ORDER BY ( MP.hitcount + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PROD_PICK WHERE prod_code = MP.code) * 2) DESC, MP.created_at DESC, MP.code DESC
ORDER BY MP.price DESC, MP.created_at DESC, MP.code DESC
ORDER BY MP.price ASC, MP.created_at DESC, MP.code DESC
ORDER BY MP.created_at DESC, MP.code DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{perPage} ) AS MP
LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON MP.code = i.target_code AND i.type = 'market' AND i.order_seq = 1
ORDER BY ( MP.hitcount + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_PROD_PICK WHERE prod_code = MP.code) * 2) DESC, MP.code DESC
ORDER BY MP.price DESC, MP.code DESC
ORDER BY MP.price ASC, MP.code DESC
ORDER BY MP.created_at DESC, MP.code DESC

SELECT , MP.content, i.path AS image_paths FROM MARKET_PRODUCT AS MP
LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON MP.code = i.target_code AND i.type = 'market' WHERE MP.code = #{prodCode}
